name: hindsight-lite
description: Local-first memory runtime for Codex CLI using Markdown, JSONL, and static inspection tools.

interface.shortDescription: Local editable memory for Codex CLI sessions.
interface.longDescription: hindsight-lite retains Codex CLI sessions as local JSONL, recalls compact context into future prompts, and renders editable Markdown memory plus reflection trajectories in a static UI.
defaultPrompt: Recall useful context before continuing this repo task.
Show my local memory tree for this Codex bank.
Retain the important lesson from this debugging session.
